mapper.sql: select doc_id, title, file_name, file_type, file_path, status, chunk_count, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from mall_knowledge_doc
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and status = #{status} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_knowledge_doc (title, file_name, file_type, file_path, status, chunk_count, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{title}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{filePath}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{errorMsg}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update mall_knowledge_doc set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where doc_id = #{docId}
